summary.en: Add business-semantic class names to UI elements in Tailwind-heavy React/frontend code so markup keeps its layout and business meaning and stays easy to locate, read, and maintain.
summary.zh: 在前端 React/Tailwind 页面元素的 className 首位补充与样式无关、表意的语义 class name（区域前缀分组命名），恢复 UI 元素的业务/布局语义，便于定位、阅读与维护。
